
A published anchor stays put. When a revision of an accepted document is accepted, and when an accepted document is edited in place, the server compares the new text with the accepted one: an anchor the accepted version published must remain, on a heading whose number still matches it, and no anchor may exceed the depth limit. Anchors may be added (a letter-suffix insert) and bodies may change; disappearance and renaming are refused. A superseded section keeps its heading and anchor. Publication is the only way an anchor becomes published (WL-SPEC-77 §6).
